description: Any goal: relevance leans on the goal itself; page kinds describe one subject of the kind the goal is about (a product, company, issuer, meeting, case or filing).

relevance.true: The linked document is exactly the kind of document the goal asks for - the same document type, for the same subject and scope the goal names - whatever period it covers.
relevance.false: The linked document is a different kind of document than the goal asks for, even when it is about the same subject and period (for example a different report type, a summary or notice about it, a form, a policy, a key information document, or a listing page), or it is the same document translated into a language other than the language the goal is written in.

page_kinds.fund_or_product: A page about one subject of the kind the goal is about - one fund, product, company, issuer, meeting, case or filing - which usually lists that subject's own documents.
page_kinds.document_listing: A page that lists many documents (reports, announcements, disclosures, downloads).
page_kinds.category_or_overview: A page that groups or lists such subjects, without their documents.
page_kinds.news_or_article: A news item, blog post, press release or article.
page_kinds.company_or_legal: About us, contact, careers, legal notices, privacy, cookie policy, login, or similar.
